Sanctions remain a core Council tool under the UN Charter for addressing threats to peace and security, stopping weapons flows and tackling terrorism.

The humanitarian carveout does not end sanctions. It clarifies that specified organizations' activities necessary for humanitarian assistance or basic human needs do not violate UN asset freezes. That clarity matters for humanitarian providers and their service providers, helping aid reach vulnerable people more effectively and saving lives. Our support for this adopted resolution and our recorded favourable vote are established facts. They do not establish our endorsement of an unspecified future text or any future vote.<|im_end|>
